<div class="card-body">
'''A Tremor In The Force''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フォースの激震</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">配備フェイズに、裏にして相手のリザーブデッキにこのカードを入れ、よく切ること。切り終わったら、相手はカードを見ないで1回カットする。このカードがリザーブデッキの一番上にきたら、カードをロストパイルへ送る。そのターン、相手はフォースをそれ以上起動できない。（「意識操作」のカードの影響を受けない）</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">「発射準備よし……」</span>

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A Tremor in the Force.

'''Card text:''' During the deploy phase, put this card face down into the opponent's Reserve Deck and shuffle well. After shuffling, the opponent cuts once without looking at the cards. When this card reaches the top of the Reserve Deck, send it to the Lost Pile. The opponent cannot activate any more Force that turn. (Unaffected by the [[Alter|Alter]] card.)

'''Lore:''' “Ready to fire……”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says the deploy phase rather than explicitly your deploy phase, specifies cutting the deck once, and omits the English word “immediately” when the Effect is lost. Its lore says “Ready to fire” rather than “Stand by.”<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-printing">[[:File:Premiere-L-atremorintheforce-decipher-archive.gif|A Tremor In The Force English printed face]].</ref>

<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[A Tremor In The Force]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141635847/M2ODFjisZUiEiTq-44iDdA.jpg A Tremor In The Force original photograph].</ref>
